SELECT 
  a.COUNTRY AS COUNTRY_CODE,
  COUNT(f.CONNECTION_ID) AS FLIGHT_COUNT,
  SUM(f.SEATS_MAX - f.SEATS_OCCUPIED) AS TOTAL_UNOCCUPIED_SEATS

  /DMO/CONNECTION c

WHERE 
  c.ARRIVAL_TIME >= '20261001' AND c.ARRIVAL_TIME < '20261101'
GROUP BY 
  a.COUNTRY
ORDER BY 
  COUNTRY_CODE ASCENDING

sql:
SELECT 
  A.AGENCY_ID AS AGENCY_ID,
  A.NAME AS NAME,
  COUNT(T.TRAVEL_ID) AS TOTAL_TRIPS,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T.BEGIN_DATE >= '20261001' AND T.BEGIN_DATE < '20270101' THEN T.TRAVEL_ID END) AS Q4_2026_TRIPS,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T.BEGIN_DATE >= '20270101' AND T.BEGIN_DATE < '20270401' THEN T.TRAVEL_ID END) AS Q1_2027_TRIPS,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T.BEGIN_DATE < '20261001' OR (T.BEGIN_DATE >= '20270401' AND T.BEGIN_DATE < '20270701') THEN T.TRAVEL_ID END) AS OTHER_PERIODS_TRIPS
FROM 
  /DMO/AGENCY A
  INNER JOIN /DMO/TRAVEL T ON A.AGENCY_ID = T.AGENCY_ID
GROUP BY 
  A.AGENCY_ID, A.NAME
ORDER BY 
  TOTAL_TRIPS DESCENDING, A.AGENCY_ID
UP TO 10 ROWS

  SUM(t.total_price) AS total_trip_price,

SELECT 
  cCUSTOMER_ID AS CUSTOMER_NUMBER,
  cFIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME,
  cLAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME,
  cCOUNTRY_CODE AS COUNTRY_CODE
FROM 
  /DMO/CUSTOMER AS c
WHERE 
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM /DMO/AGENCY AS a 
    WHERE a.COUNTRY_CODE = c.COUNTRY_CODE 
      AND a.AGENCY_ID IN (
        SELECT t.AGENCY_ID 
        FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS t 
        WHERE t.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
      )
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM /DMO/AGENCY AS a 
    WHERE a.COUNTRY_CODE <> c.COUNTRY_CODE 
      AND a.AGENCY_ID IN (
        SELECT t.AGENCY_ID 
        FROM /DMO/TRAVEL AS t 
        WHERE t.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
      )
  )
ORDER BY 
  cCOUNTRY_CODE ASCENDING,
  cFIRST_NAME ASCENDING,
  cLAST_NAME ASCENDING

  f.FLIGHT_DATE AS FLIGHT_DATE,
  f.CARRIER_ID AS CARRIER_ID,
  f.CONNECTION_ID AS CONNECTION_ID,
  c.NAME AS CARRIER_NAME,
  COUNT(DISTINCT b.AGENCY_ID) AS AGENCY_COUNT,
  COUNT(b.BOOKING_ID) AS BOOKING_COUNT
FROM 
  /DMO/FLIGHT f
  JOIN /DMO/CARRIER c ON f.CARRIER_ID = c.CARRIER_ID
  JOIN /DMO/BOOKING b ON f.CONNECTION_ID = b.CONNECTION_ID AND f.FLIGHT_DATE = b.FLIGHT_DATE
  JOIN /DMO/TRAVEL t ON b.TRAVEL_ID = t.TRAVEL_ID
  JOIN /DMO/AGENCY a ON t.AGENCY_ID = a.AGENCY_ID
GROUP BY 
  f.FLIGHT_DATE,
  f.CARRIER_ID,
  f.CONNECTION_ID,
  c.NAME
HAVING 
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.AGENCY_ID) >= 2
ORDER BY 
  f.FLIGHT_DATE ASCENDING,
  f.CARRIER_ID ASCENDING,
  f.CONNECTION_ID ASCENDING
UP TO 20 ROWS
